(11.2) The differential inequality is global in distributions. The offsets uj − V are continuous and locally Lipschitz on all of R3; perr j ≥ 0 is bounded and supported in |y| ≤ rj. For each fixed system and step, the offsets have deterministic size and Lipschitz bounds on every compact set; the errors have deterministic size bounds. Universally, E ∫︂ perr j ≤ Cr32 0 + C ∑︂ i<j r 19/2−3w i ≤ C (︂ r32 0 + r 19/2−3w j )︂ , w = 10−5 . (11.3) In particular this is at most C(s32 + s19/2−3w).
